title: You Need to Leave
blurb: Customer-service composure applied to what is unmistakably an eviction. Unlike a shouted GET OUT, this maintains a level, professional tone throughout, which somehow makes it worse — there is no heat to argue with, only a decision that was reached before you were told. It is the sound for guests who have outstayed the evening, jokes that went one step past the line, and intrusive thoughts being shown the door. Security has been notified, the exit is that way, and you need to leave.
